candidates.comment: Thanks for the report. This is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346692, including creating child sessions in new worktrees from a workspace-less quick chat. This report adds confirmation on macOS with 1.147.0-insider.

Thanks for the report. Markdown Preview outline support is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/342919, which describes the same missing outline when switching from source to preview. This report also records the behavior on VS Code 1.145.0 with macOS Darwin arm64 27.2.0.

Thanks for the report. This matches the macOS 27 Agents Window control overlap tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/338530. This report adds that it affects VS Code 1.145.2 on Darwin arm64 27.2.0 and makes the Side Bar toggle difficult to click.

Thanks for the report. The custom-agent model selection problem is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/342582. This report adds that the manual Sonnet selection persists across new sessions in VS Code 1.145.3 on Windows and clears only after restarting VS Code.

Thanks for the report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/326584: clicking Enable in Settings searches for `agentDebugLog` but shows no settings. Your Windows 1.145.2 confirmation and full-setting-ID workaround provide additional evidence for that issue.

Thanks for the report. This matches the WSL changed-files navigation failure tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346242, where files exist but opening them from chat reports that they cannot be found. Your report also confirms the symptom on stable 1.145.2.
Thanks for flagging this. The same report is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/338433. The repository contains an MIT license in LICENSE.txt, linked from the README.

Thanks for the detailed diagnosis. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/342774 already tracks this exact disconnected-client error, the missing host recovery, and runtime-exit diagnostics. This report adds the Windows managed-settings restart sequence and CI failures in builds 493134 and 494061; those should remain linked as additional recovery cases.

Thanks for the detailed report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346490, which tracks multi-root Copilot Harness Undo failing with this exact error while Keep works. Your reproduction adds a non-Git primary folder and a one-line Markdown edit in a second folder on Windows 11 with VS Code 1.145.2.

Thanks for the request. This is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/304713, which requests the same Search-style tree layout for References. Your use case of navigating many results with independently collapsible nodes belongs there too.

Thanks for the detailed report. Long literal searches producing this warning and misleading "No results" output are already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/220021. This report adds Windows 10 / VS Code 1.145.2 reproduction with extensions disabled, including multiline code snippets and an approximate 4,000-character trigger.

Thanks for the report. This matches the coded-symbol upload HTTP 413 failure tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/343839. This report adds confirmation on Windows with VS Code 1.145.2 and the server response 'length limit exceeded'.

Thanks for the report. This matches the persistent Keep failure tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/344973, including the same error on Windows with VS Code 1.145.2. This report adds that restarting VS Code and temporarily removing/restoring the changes do not recover language.tsx or App.tsx, while other files can still be kept.

Thanks for the report. This matches the Windows-to-remote Linux chat file-list navigation problem tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346020. This report adds confirmation on 1.145.2 with WSL Ubuntu: direct opening and Open Changes in Diff Editor work, but clicking the file list fails and reloading does not help.

Thanks for the report. Automatic recovery without manually clicking Retry, while keeping the error visible, is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/288094. This report adds the network-interruption case: agents should recover when connectivity returns rather than require each request to be restarted manually.

Thanks for the report. This repeats https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346579, including the Windows 1.145.2 startup steps, logs, and Refresh workaround. That thread also has an independent confirmation, so let's consolidate the investigation there.

Thanks for the report. This matches the remote changed-file widget problem tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/346023. This report adds an Arch Linux-to-Debian reproduction on 1.145.0 and confirms that creating the same path locally makes the widget open the local copy; those details should be retained in the investigation.

Thanks for the report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/246105: deleting lines can leave inline Git blame before the remaining code. This report adds a screenshot and a newer reproduction on macOS arm64 with Insiders 1.145.0, which should be retained with the existing issue.

Thanks for the report and the additional confirmation. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/302887, which tracks renamed conversations reverting when selected. Consolidating there should retain this report's Windows/SSH context, the name initially surviving reload, and the sidebar/editor-tab mismatch, including the two-conversation switching and reload checks.

Thanks for the report and the additional reproductions. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/338194, which also includes Ubuntu 26.10 with VS Code 1.142.0. Consolidating there; this thread adds confirmation on two clean installations, an OS application-closure notification, and failures affecting multiple extensions and updates—not only Google Antigravity.

Thanks for the report and screenshot. This is the same Keep/Undo toolbar overlap tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/307560. This report adds a Windows 10 example on VS Code 1.141.0 and a screenshot showing obscured code: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/341055#issuecomment-6716305651.
